historical_question.question: Under Hypnosis, can a copied upgraded Build or Animals card bypass your own corresponding upgrade, can copied Association I gain a third partner when yours is upgraded, and whose Build side governs a unique building played via copied Sponsors?

historical_answer.expected_answer: Copied upgraded Build allows its special enclosures and upgrade-marked map spaces even if your Build is I; copied upgraded Animals allows upgrade-conditioned animals even if yours is I. Copied Association I cannot take a third partner zoo even if your own Association is II. When copied Sponsors plays a unique building, your own Build side determines permission for upgrade-marked map spaces.
